name: fairness-fico
title: Every fairness constraint has a price, and the prices differ by a factor of 40
subtitle: Lending on 301,536 TransUnion credit scores (2003), four racial groups, default = 90+ days late. Profit under each decision rule as a fraction of the unconstrained maximum.
source: Hardt, Price & Srebro, NeurIPS 2016, FICO case study
